_readme: Sound and music settings for scripts/autoload/AudioManager.gd (UPGRADE_PLAN_V2 steps 9, 25, 26). There are NO downloaded sound files: every sound and every music track is made in code, so they are free to use (made by the team). sfx: a sound name -> a file path. Leave "file" empty to use the code-made recipe of the same name in game_data.json "sounds" (a missing name plays a simple beep). music: one recipe per situation (state). voices: the beep-talk pitch for each speaker. buses: the starting volume of each volume slider (0 = silent, 1 = full).

sfx._readme: Put a real sound file path here later (for example res://assets/sounds/door.ogg) and it is used instead of the code-made one. Write its source in AGENT_SOURCE.md.

music._readme: Each state is a short loop made in code. bpm = beats per minute; root_hz = the key note; progression = the chords, each a list of notes in semitones above the root; beats_per_chord = how long each chord lasts; pad / arp / bass / drums = how loud each layer is (0 = off); arp_pattern = which chord notes the arpeggio plays, one per eighth note; arp_octave = 1 plays the arpeggio one octave up; wave = sine (soft) or triangle (brighter). crossfade_seconds = how long one track fades into the next. chunk_samples = how many samples are made per frame (bigger = ready sooner, but can stutter in the browser).

difficulty._readme: UPGRADE_PLAN_V2 step 25 DEFAULT: the tension track plays a little faster and adds a drum layer for the Janitor, and more for the Student. speed multiplies the bpm; extra_drums is added to the drums layer.

scenes._readme: Which music state each screen starts. A screen that is not listed keeps the music that is already playing. "planet" = the mission's own state (moon, mars or venus).
scenes.name: calm

voices._readme: Beep-talk (no recorded voices, UPGRADE_PLAN_V2 section 7): while a line types out, the speaker beeps at their own pitch. pitch_hz = the beep's note; every letters_per_beep letters make one beep; pitch_wobble = how much each beep's pitch changes at random (0.1 = 10%).

source: Game-design choice. All sounds and music are generated in code (made by the team, free to use).
